title: Undrafted rookie Dominic Zvada opens Giants kicking competition

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Undrafted rookie Dominic Zvada opens Giants kicking competition
sources.description: Undrafted rookie Dominic Zvada fired the opening salvo Saturday at Giants rookie minicamp in what is expected to be a kicking competition pitting him against incumbent Ben Sauls and former All-Pro Jason Sanders.
